verdict: Leads are steady; Google spend with zero returns is being addressed now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 138 leads at a cost of $15.80 per lead across $2,181 in total spend — all of that lead volume came through Meta. Google Ads consumed $509 of that budget and produced zero leads from 115 clicks, which is a confirmed drain that is being corrected this period. Meta ads are also running dark on Saturdays and Sundays, which is a structural schedule gap — not seasonal — and is being fixed to keep leads flowing through the full week. Weekend downtime is already reflected in a short-term dip in the most recent days; expect lead volume to stabilize as coverage is restored. Several build milestones — including landing pages and creative — are past their target dates and are being closed out, which will unlock the next phase of scaling.
